output.title: Issuer short name `iss` is additive and not used here
output.content: The change adds an `iss` kubectl short name for the `Issuer` resource, a purely additive convenience. The environment summary shows only cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and apps/v1 Deployment manifests, and only certificates.cert-manager.io is an installed CRD. No Issuer manifest or values key is shown that this short name would affect. Nothing in the excerpts says existing resources or configuration change behavior.
